quotes.speaker: Jaylen Brown
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Brown on the challenge of building chemistry with a new roster
quotes.excerpt: We got like six or seven new guys that are here, so on one foot we just got to figure out the spacing.
quotes.quote: We got like six or seven new guys that are here, so on one foot we just got to figure out the spacing and be disciplined in that. And on another note, sometimes you just got to go out and play. Sometimes I get caught thinking a little bit too much, trying to make sure everybody's in their spots, and you just got to go get a basket because that's what the team needs.
quotes.social_post: Jaylen Brown admits he sometimes gets caught thinking too much about spacing with the new 76ers roster and needs to focus on just going out and getting a basket when the team needs it.

structured.context: Jaylen Brown discusses the challenges of integrating several new players and balancing discipline with instinctive play.
